description: Query and manage Google NotebookLM notebooks from the terminal

tools.name: notebooks_list
tools.description: List all NotebookLM notebooks with ID, title, and source count.

tools.name: notebooks_get
tools.description: Get notebook details including source list. Required: notebook-id.

tools.name: notebooks_create
tools.description: Create a new notebook. Required: title.

tools.name: notebooks_describe
tools.description: Get AI-generated summary and suggested topics for a notebook. Required: notebook-id.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Ask a question against a notebook's sources. Required: notebook-id, question.

tools.name: cross_query
tools.description: Query across multiple notebooks with aggregated citations. Required: question.

tools.name: sources_list
tools.description: List sources in a notebook. Required: notebook-id.

tools.name: sources_add
tools.description: Add a source to a notebook (URL, text, file, or Drive doc). Required: notebook-id, one of --url/--text/--file/--drive.

tools.name: sources_content
tools.description: Get raw text content of a source. Required: source-id.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Cache notebook source content to local SQLite for offline full-text search.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across synced notebook data. Required: query. Run sync first.

tools.name: studio_create
tools.description: Create a studio artifact (audio, video, report, slides, etc). Required: notebook-id, --type.

tools.name: research_start
tools.description: Start a research task (fast or deep mode). Required: notebook-id, query.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Health check: verify nlm binary, auth status, and database accessibility.
